description: Lists the Cloud sites, Data projects, Studio apps, or Mobile Expo starters this account owns, for exactly one product. The only action is list. Use list_projects to find ids. Use create_project to make a new project, project to read or save one row, and status for a cross-product snapshot that includes guidancePending. product code returns the browser-workspace note and does not list server projects.

product.description: Which product to list. One of cloud, data, studio, mobile, or code. code returns the browser-workspace note.

name: list_projects
title: List projects for one product
